# Rhydham Mittal

> Full-stack engineer and founder based in Chandigarh, India. Builds full web products end-to-end — frontend, backend, data layer, and SEO — and is available for freelance work worldwide.

## About

- Founder of MentalSaathi, a peer-support mental wellness platform for students (mentalsaathi.in), built solo from concept to production in 6 weeks.
- Built CollabFluenz (collabfluenz.com) as a freelance full-stack engagement for an external founder — a creator × brand collaboration marketplace.
- Built a real-time Sign Language to Text Converter using computer vision (OpenCV, MediaPipe, scikit-learn) at GDG Hacks, 91% accuracy on a custom 26-class ASL dataset.
- Created and maintains mango (mangoframe on PyPI), an open-source FastAPI + SQLAlchemy scaffolding framework.
- B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) at Chandigarh University, 2024–2028.
